issue.title: Copy chips phase 3: vault-wide snippet picker, masked copy* chips, rich-text card copy, per-note opt-out

task_type_fields.proposal: Implement the research report's deferred phase 3 for bob-copy-chips (research:202611/obsidian_copy_chips/obsidian_copy_chips.md): (1) a vault-wide "Copy a snippet…" picker over every copy chip and bob-copy fence; (2) a masked `copy*` chip variant whose face hides the payload; (3) rich-text (HTML) copy from a bob-copy card; (4) a per-note opt-out from chip rendering. Each should reuse api.copyChips v1 (parse/scanLine/serialize/chipAt/copy) and the conformance vectors in bob-plugins scripts/fixtures/copy-chips-vectors.json. Masked chips must not claim to be a secret store (plan non-goal A8).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The copy-chips epic bob-cli-ni (plan:202611/copy_chips.md) deliberately shipped only research phases 1–2 plus vault adoption; its plan defers phase 3 and asks the adopt phase to record it as a proposed follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-ni.6 (note #2) and deferred by the approved copy-chips plan; the bob-cli-ni land agent filed it so the deferred research phase is tracked.
